6.391 rsInvalidIntersectionNaturalCrossJoin
Applies to RDL 2011/01
rsInvalidIntersectionNaturalCrossJoin is a critical error that occurs when Relationship.JoinConditions is
not specified and the Relationship is used to correlate an intersection scope to a containing group
scope or DefaultRelationship.JoinConditions is not specified and the DefaultRelationship is used to
correlate an intersection scope to a containing group scope.
